summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch yields (patch, coords) with coordinates computed by removing padding offsets; set_rnd skips double-underscore attributes); monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset reworked with patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; NumPy ceiling for worker split; NotImplementedError for missing len; PatchDataset docstring uses float); monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter); docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc after GridPatchDataset); tests/test_grid_dataset.py (new TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape and test_loading_array using the pinned values). Not verified by execution: the pinned values and pytest results are unconfirmed. Choices to review: set_determinism(1234) is called in setUp and again at the start of test_loading_array; coordinates are dtype int. Pre-existing lines over 120 chars in get_valid_patch_size's docstring were left untouched.
